description:
I'm Ethan. I turned 60 this year, and my mother Ruth is 84 and lives alone.

That's how I ended up learning the difference between what actually keeps a door shut and what just gets sold to frightened people at forty dollars a month. Most of it costs nothing. Almost none of it needs a subscription.

So this channel is the free half first — the old habits, the nine-second walk before dark, the three-inch screws that cost less than lunch. Then the honest half: which gear is worth your money, which is a plastic promise, and what I'd never put in my own mother's house.

Whether you live alone, you lie awake about a parent who does, or you just want yours to be the house they walk past — pick one video and do one thing before dark tonight.
